answer: Harness fingerprint attestation hashes each agent's runtime build, clock skew, prompt scaffold and tool-call cadence into a signed badge checked by a five-peer quorum. Minting one needs a per-identity bond plus attestation fee, capped at two attempts hourly and a six-hour trust ramp. A fake farm pays that per identity, but a coordinated ring still collides on shared build and cadence hashes; peers flip the lantern flag, quarantine the cluster, and block its saffron-tagged payouts at the next summit quorum.
